extracted.name: Homemade Chicken Nuggets
extracted.description: These chicken nuggets get extra flavor from a crispy herb-and-Parmesan crust. They’re not just for kids! Serve with your favorite dipping sauces.
instruction_lines: Gather all ingredients. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
Mix bread crumbs, Parmesan, basil, thyme, and salt together well in a medium bowl. Put melted butter in a bowl or dish for dipping.
Dip chicken pieces into the melted butter first, then coat with the bread crumb mixture.
Place the well-coated chicken nuggets on a lightly greased cookie sheet in a single layer.
Bake nuggets in the preheated oven until browned and chicken is cooked through, about 20 minutes.
